name: Elements | Ultra Thin Single Wide Double Pack
description: Elements rolling papers are made with pure rice paper. No chemicals, no pulp, and no hemp. A thin line of Acacia gum is added to the rolling paper. The rolling papers burn completely clean except for a tiny line of residue from the Acacia gum caramelizing. If you're looking for a very clean and very slow burning rolling paper, then look no further.
